info.title: API for Finanstilsynet's registry
info.description:
This API delivers information about legal entities (persons or companies)
with licences that are used when operating in Norway, or licences approved by Finanstilsynet and used
abroad. The same information can be found, in a human-readable format, in
[Finanstilsynet's registry](https://www.finanstilsynet.no/en/finanstilsynets-registry/) (Norwegian: *Virksomhetsregisteret*).

## General info about paged results
For paged results, we return a maximum of 300 pages with
50 results per page. This means that we cannot guarantee
that we return all possible results for broad queries.

## Rate limiting
The API is rate limited to prevent abuse and to ensure that all clients can access the API. The default rate limit is
1000
requests per 60
seconds per client IP address.

The json report endpoint has a stricter limit of 5
requests per 60
seconds per client IP address.

## Caching
Responses from GET endpoints are cached for up to
3600
seconds. Identical requests within this period return the same result, even if the registry has been updated in the meantime.
Cached responses still count towards the rate limit. `/legal-entities` (by ids) and the custom reports (`/report` and
`/report/json`) are not cached.

## Versioning
The API is versioned with v2 returning an extended version of LicenceTypesDetails from
'/licence-types'. In addition, several extra properties was been added to `/filter` and `/search`
in both versions of the API. The extra properties can be used to narrow down the hits returned.

As some of the extensions are breaking changes we saw it necessary to introduce API versioning.
Version v1 will still be supported for the time being, but we do recommend that all consumers
start using v2.

finanstilsynetId.description: Finanstilsynet provides an identifier for all companies and persons that are in the registry. The identifier has the format of `FT00000000'.

organisationNumber.description: The organisation number of the entity. Applies to Norwegian (registered) companies only.

leiCode.description: Applies to companies only. This is the international company code required to operate in some financial markets.

auditorNumber.description: Applies to Auditor-licencees only. This is the official auditor number assigned when the auditor becomes a registered auditor.

name.description: The natural name of a person, or the company name.

addresses.description: The registered addresses for the entity

links.description: A list of links/URLs to the company.

relationsToOther.description: A list of relations this entity has with other companies.

participants.description: A list of participants of this company. Mostly used for Auditor/accountant-licencees.

participatesIn.description: A list of companies this entity participates in. Mostly used for Auditor/accountant-licencees.

remarks.description: Any additional information about the legal entity

Licence.description: Information about a licence. The licence can either be granted directly to an entity, or it can be used by a branch or an agent of a licence holder.

licensedEntity.description: The legal entity granted the licences.

serviceProviderId.description: The legal entity providing the service. This can be a different entity than the licensed entity.

licenceClassification.description: Any subclassification of the licence, if applicable.

supervisoryAuthority.description: The legal authority granting and regulating this licence.

hasSecurity.description: Status for any required financial security for this licence.

registeredDate.description: The registration date of this licence.

serviceProviderType.description: The relation this service provider has to the licence.

remarks.description: Any relevant remarks to the granted licence

services.description: Lists any services granted within this licence. Only populated if Finanstilsynet is the supervisory authority for this licence.

borderCrossingActivity.description: Lists any border-crossing activity related to Norway registered on this licence.

cooperationGroups.description: Any cooperation groups for the licence. Applicable to auditors and auditor companies.

roles.description: A list of roles related to the licence, in context of the current service provider.

agentsOrBranches.description: A list of agents or branches using the granted licence. Only applies when the ServiceProviderType is 'Licensed'.

accreditedAuditors.description: A list of auditors connected to this auditor company. Applies to auditor licences only.

auditorFor.description: A list of legal entities for which the service provider provides audits.

accreditedAuditorsDetailed.description: A list of auditors connected to this auditor company. Applies to auditor licences only.

LegalEntityReference.description: A reference to a legal entity in the registry.

legalEntityId.description: The entity identifier for the legal entity.

legalEntityName.description: The natural name or company name

code.description: The identifier for the licence type.

name.description: The name of the licence type.

description.description: A short description of the licence, possibly stating the legal framwork under which it is granted.

LicenceClassification.description: Information about the classifications for a licence type. Each licence can have zero or one classification at any given time. Classifications are used solely for Auditor-licences.

licenceClassificationId.description: The identifier for the classification type.

code.description: An alphanumerical code for the classification.

name.description: A short description of the classification

allOf.description: A reference to a legal entity in the registry, including its country.

country.description: The country of residence for the legal entity.

LicenceService.description: Information about a service within a licence.

groupName.description: The name of the service group.

serviceInstruments.description: Lists any financial instruments within this service

ServiceInstrument.description: Information about financial instruments within a service.

name.description: The name of the financial instrument type.

description.description: The description of the financial instrument type.

BorderCrossingActivity.description: Information about the border-crossing of a licence service, originating from a home contry, to one or more host countries.

homeCountry.description: The home country, i.e. the country in which the service originates. Is the same as the country of the licence's supervisory authority.

service.description: The service being border-crossed. The field is null if and only if the licence type does not have a specified set of services. In that case the services are defined implicitly by the licence type, and are border-crossed together.

borderCrossings.description: Each item in this list represents a border-crossing of the service to one host country, by one service provider (either the licence holder itself or an agent or branch). Note that the service may be border-crossed to the same country by multiple service providers.

BorderCrossingActivityDetails.description: Details regarding a border-crossing activity. An activity consists of a provider and a host contry. If the service is provided through a third contry, this transit country is included in the registration.

hostCountry.description: The host country, i.e. the country in which the service is being provided

transitCountry.description: If not null: The service provider is located in a third country, different from both the home- and host countries, and the service is being transited through that country.

serviceProvider.description: The legal entity which provides the service in the host country.

serviceProviderType.description: The service provider's relation to the licence.

uri.description: The URI for the cooperation group.

RelationType.description: A group of legal entities that all have the same relation to the current legal entity.

description.description: A description of the relation type.

relatedEntities.description: A list of legal entities having the same relation type.

allOf.description: Reference to a legal entity in the registry, including country and the service provider type (i.e. Agent or Branch).
A reference to a licenced auditor associated with the company.

isEngagementPartner.description: Whether the auditor is responsible for an audit engagement.

Address.description: Defines an address for a legal entity.

addressLines.description: Detail lines for the address, e.g. house/suite, street name and number, postal code (for most of the non-norwegian addresses)

postalCode.description: The postal code. Mostly used for domestic addresses, but is also supplied for some foreign addresses

postalLocation.description: Used for Town/postal names. Will have the official name for norwegian postal codes, for foreign addresses the data is manually added and not validated.

region.description: Region ("fylke") where this postal code is located

country.description: The country for the legal entity. For some legal entities this is the only part of the address we know, and is added to assist in detecting border-crossing activities.

Link.description: An external reference related to a licence. Used for references to "Forsikringsagentregisteret" or "Finansagentregisteret".

title.description: A header/title describing what the Url is pointing to

englishUrl.description: The actual URL to the english reference site.

norwegianUrl.description: The actual URL to the norwegian reference site.

EntityRelation.description: Information about the relation a legal entity has to another entity.

legalEntityItem.description: A link to the related legal entity.

allOf.description: Information on a licence type, including which classifications and services might occur for licences of the type.

possibleClassifications.description: If non-empty, instances of the licence type must have one of these classifications.

possibleServiceGroups.description: If non-empty, instances of the licence type could be granted one or more of the services in each of the service groups.
